name: WOLF
description: WOLF is a multi-agent social deduction benchmark based on the Werewolf game, designed to measure deception production and detection in LLMs through role-grounded agents and structured interaction logs capturing honesty and suspicion over time.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the social-deduction/LLM-agent literature that is gaining attention for studying deception and theory-of-mind behaviors, but is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Captures dynamic, adversarial deception interactions with detailed statement-level and round-level analysis; includes public code repository.
